classifiedFinding.title: _updatePhUSDEmissionRate truncates phUSDPerSecond to zero at low totalStaked × low APY

classification.assetImpact: Silent under-payment of phUSD rewards at boundary configurations (sub-1bps APY or sub-MINIMUM_STAKE positions).
attackPath: 3. phUSD accrual stops silently for that configuration window.
classification.assumptions: Very low TVL combined with very low APY

classifiedFinding.justification: Precision boundary defect with dust-level impact. Per C4 special-cases for fees/yield: dust/rounding → QA. Recommend reordering to multiply-first or scale the accumulator.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-low. Classifier agrees: QA.
